entries.name: carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P])
carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P]).carries a criterion a row cites by number in its text to its ID, lists each, and names what it cannot carry
carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P]).carries every number a row names, before, between and after its notes, and says which criterion a note described
carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P]).changes nothing the second time
carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P]).leaves a row it cannot carry as it was, and names it with why
carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P]).leaves a row whole, and names it, where a number after its list may be another criterion
carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P]).rewrites the numbers and ranges a row opens with to the IDs they name, keeping the rest of the row
carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P]).says how many links name a spec it rewrote, and what lists them
carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P]).says how many links name a spec it rewrote, and what lists them.links
carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P]).says what it would change on a dry run, and writes nothing
carrying Tests rows from numbers to IDs ([R6P]).writes, and exits non-zero naming each row it left, from the command
